_comment: Barracks LEVEL progression (WO-771.9 foundation). Level 1 is the day-one baseline: zero cost, zero build time, unlocks the starting roster (Footman + Archer). Each subsequent level unlocks 0-2 new troops and costs escalating resources + wall-clock build time. unlocksTroopIds MUST match ids in troops.json. cost is DeNelle.Village.ResourceCost (wood/food/iron/crystals/coins) so EconomyService.CanAfford/TrySpend consume it directly. DUAL-COPY RULE (BINDING): mirrored byte-identical at Assets/StreamingAssets/Data/Canonical/barracks.json AND Assets/Resources/Data/Canonical/barracks.json (Resources wins in WebGL). Levels align with troops.json unlockBarracksTier (1..6).
